issues.title: As participant in Collaborative Working, I need to see the feedback history for a message
issues.body:
If I am being asked to modify a document (or it has been endorsed), then I need to view the feedback provided.

I certainly need to view the most recent feedback, and optionally previous items too.

The `Channel COA message detail` component should be extended to show the feedback on a message - with date and author.

I _guess_ this could be a block at the bottom of the control.  I should see the most recent feedback item, with a collapsed set of rows beneath it.  A `more` button/link should expand the feedback.

I _guess_ this feedback block should _steal_ vertical space, and the JSON-Editor (enabled or disabled) should get scroll-bars when necessary.  Hmm, no. That's wrong. The status board can be of infinite length.  So, the JSON-editor can always be full height. It's the channel that has scroll bars.

![mockups](https://docs.google.com/drawings/d/e/2PACX-1vS6VPxX4oPSXeiqOQmTbR5nzeKpRHj0BhUr3ZCcTuol246Ax7_HvoCHDxeZEzobWOuW_gKB-c2TLUAQ/pub?w=1065&h=638)

One change please (Which I can fix on Monday if you aren't able to).

For the old "RFI Messges" board, we looked for RFI messages in all channels, and collated them together.

But for the new collaborative working status board - it replaces a normal channel.  So, the Game Designer creates a special "Collab Editing" channel in the admin pages, called (for example) "Blue COAs".  Then in the client, when we're creating the tabs if it's a "Collab Editing" channel - we show the new status board for that channel, instead of the old list of messages.

Hope this makes sense :-)

As I said - I can change this on Monday, if you aren't able to.
